subject.title: feat(agents): agent-controlled session status, attention, and TTL in the sessions tool

question: Should the sessions tool permanently expose agent-controlled statusNote, attention, and ttlMinutes as a persisted gateway/session contract with the proposed automatic clearing rules?
rationale: This is a new model-facing protocol and persisted session-state capability, so tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine the intended long-term product contract or operator expectations.

options.title: Sponsor the current contract
options.body: Keep the existing three-field design and merge after real gateway lifecycle proof confirms declaration and every intended clearing boundary.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Reduce the exposed fields or persistence semantics before merge if agent-declared sidebar presence should remain a smaller or less durable capability.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if the agent-controlled status layer needs broader sidebar-product direction before adding it to the gateway protocol.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current contract
recommendation.body: Keep the existing three-field design and merge after real gateway lifecycle proof confirms declaration and every intended clearing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the adjacent attention and narration surfaces makes this person the best available routing candidate for the intended contract.
